published_statement: 1804.05382 p.2: from the Wightman function of a massless scalar, 'pi^2/30 [k_B T(tau)]^4 = lim_{x'->x} [d/dtau d/dtau' G~+_A(x',x)]  (15), matching the Stefan-Boltzmann law for scalar radiation'; p.10: 'We precisely recover the Stefan-Boltzmann factor of pi^2/30 for scalar radiation'. 2512.15610 p.5-6: thermal state by compactifying imaginary time, alpha = (beta,0,0,0), G^(11) = 2 SUM_{l0>=1} G0(x - x' - i beta l0 n0) (eq 27), 'in the flat-space limit ... it is reduced to the well-known Stefan-Boltzmann law for a massless scalar field: T00(T) = -pi^2(1+xi)/(30 beta^4)  (33)' [sign by that paper's convention; the factor (1+xi) see later_literature]. At xi = 0 (the tree's minimal coupling) both restatements give |rho| = pi^2/(30 beta^4) in hbar = c = k_B = 1.
published_hypotheses: a FREE (non-interacting) quantised field -- the Bose occupation n(omega) = 1/(e^{beta omega} - 1) and the Wick/quasifree structure presuppose it (2512.15610 eq 23-24: free propagator G0 = -1/(k^2 + i eps))
MASSLESS: omega = |k| (1804.05382 eq 4; 2512.15610 eq 1 'massless scalar field')

thermal equilibrium at inverse temperature beta = 1/T, i.e. a KMS/Gibbs state, realised as imaginary-time periodicity (2512.15610 eq 26: 'beta = 1/T representing the compactification of the time dimension', topology S^1 x R^3)
FLAT Minkowski spacetime (2512.15610 eq 33 is explicitly 'the flat-space limit'; curvature and redshift change it, eq 31)
INFINITE spatial volume, no boundaries (R^3 factor of the topology; a spatial compactification adds Casimir and thermal-Casimir terms, 2512.15610 eqs 36-50)
renormalised by subtracting the Minkowski vacuum (2512.15610 eq 19-20; KF eq 3.26-3.27: the n = 0 image dropped, i.e. normal ordering against the Minkowski vacuum)
ONE real scalar degree of freedom; the coefficient is pi^2/30 per bosonic dof (photons, 2 dof, give pi^2/15 -- computed here, not read)
rest frame of the bath: rho is T00 in the frame in which the state is isotropic; p = rho/3 (Boltzmann's radiation relation) is the isotropic, traceless case

lacked_data: What the originators had: Stefan (1879) an empirical T^4 fit; Boltzmann (1884) a thermodynamic derivation of T^4 from radiation pressure p = u/3; neither could fix the coefficient, which needs Bose/quantum statistics (Planck 1900) -- the classics are NAMED-NOT-READ, so their data are not quoted. What came later: quantum statistics (the coefficient pi^2/30 per dof is then a theorem: Gamma(4) zeta(4)/(2 pi^2)), a 50-ppm measurement of the Planck spectrum (FIRAS, read), and the 2019 SI making sigma exact (computed). None moves the conclusion as the tree uses it: in hbar = c = k_B = 1 for one free massless scalar in flat infinite space, the value is pure mathematics and is re-derived here three independent ways. The law does move when its hypotheses are broken -- mass (m/T = 1 lowers rho by 11.0%, computed), interactions, finite volume/boundaries (thermal-Casimir terms, 2512.15610), curvature/redshift (2512.15610 eq 31) -- but none of these is in the tree's use. Evidence on M's hypothesis for THIS result is against it: no missing datum was found that changes the conclusion; later data strengthened it. The one caution is scope, not data: the tree's word 'blackbody radiation' (fluctuation.py:89) and 'photons' (noise.py:136) for the scalar model; the EM field's fluctuation numbers differ (Delta' = 1/3 vs 2/3, computed here).
